concerns: Level 2: shared family module extractors/community_calendar.py (new file) used by eans.py and theabn.py. Rationale: the harness proved the two Community Calendar pages are the same YourMembership markup (span#EventList<id>, dd/mm/yyyy [» dd/mm/yyyy], Location line; detail #SpTitleBar, bold date line, When/Where rows, body after 'Go to Upcoming Event List'); parsing was verified identical on 3 EANS and 3 ABN detail pages. Each society file is constants only (ROOT, SOCIETY, DEFAULT_SPECIALTY) plus EANS's extra_shells hook.

Relevance (Level 2): the calendar holds only ABN's own meetings (Student Day, Annual Meeting 2027 and 2028); all kept. Administrative titles (AGM, general assembly, committee/board/council meetings, fundraising) are dropped by title and logged at INFO; none present today. The hand-written 'Non ABN Events' page (third-party meetings, ABN disclaims them, no date structure) is NOT scraped.

Terms: theabn.org and eans.org show only the YourMembership privacy statement / legal link (no site terms of use, nothing about automated access or AI); robots.txt only disallows /global_inc/ and /global_engine/ (Allow for css/js), crawl via the browser. No login used.

Shared-file ask (Level 3, not done): extractors/discovery.py `_fetch_html` is httpx-only and never launches Playwright, so same-site sub-pages on Cloudflare-challenged hosts (eans.org, theabn.org) return fetch_failed (observed with a scratch discover() run: Register.aspx / attendees.asp / /page/concessions all fetch_failed), and those failed same-site fetches use up the 2-fetch budget before the organiser_url external hop is tried (EANS Functional Neurosurgery Course: qssimulationcentre.com never fetched). Suggested: try `organiser_url` first, or do not count fetch_failed against max_html, or allow a browser fetch for hosts the extractor marks challenged. The external hop does work when it runs (WFNS spinalkurs.org: followed, identity strong, no fees on that page).

HQ LESSON #95: regexes accept single or double quotes (WFNS raw HTML uses single quotes, the rendered DOM double); extract_detail reads page.content() (the rendered DOM the pipeline sees) and only falls back to fetch_html when the page lacks the markup.

Taxonomy ask: society code 'ABN' needs an entry in medconf-website/src/lib/taxonomy/societies.ts (Association of British Neurologists, specialist, UK) and the scraper_sources row/registry/CI group are the foreman's. Specialty is the fixed society field 'Neurology' (single-specialty calendar).

robots.txt (fetched once via fetch_html 2026-11-13, identical on eans.org and theabn.org; quoted verbatim): 'User-agent: *' Disallow: /global_inc/ ; Allow: /global_inc/*.css ; Allow: /global_inc/*.js ; 'User-agent: *' Disallow: /global_engine/ajax/ ; then Disallow: /global_engine/ for the agents *Google*, *googlebot*, *Slurp*, *sitecheck*, *mercator*, *ia_archiver*, *webcrawler*, *msnbot*, *scooter*; Sitemap: https://www.<host>/autositemapindex.xml. Nothing under /events/ or /page/ is disallowed, so Register.aspx and /page/... fetches pass robots_gate.allowed().

FM-3C: community_calendar now fetches, robots-checked and sequential, (a) each event's own /events/Register.aspx?id=<id> and (b) the same-site /page/... event page linked from the entry; fees via pricing_tables, public rates only, tiers carry evidence_url/own_page; venue and abstract only when the detail page lacks them.

Result for ABN (harness): no row gained fees. Register.aspx redirects to unable_to_register ('Registration Not Permitted') for Student Day, and the 2027 microsite says 'Programme and registration information: Coming soon'; Student Day microsite says 'Free Event' with no currency, so no tier is written (logged). Rows that gained other fields from the microsite page: ABN Annual Meeting 2027 gained venue_name 'ICC' (site: 'will be held in Belfast at the ICC') and abstract_deadline 2027-01-18 (site: 'Monday 18th Jan 2027 at 23:59'); Student Day gained abstract_open False + abstract_deadline 2026-10-12 (UK-student call, closed). Provenance caveat: these values are stamped by the pipeline with the calendar URL as own_page although they were read from the linked /page/ URL; a discovery-side fix would make the evidence URL exact.

city_from_title now rejects Online/Virtual/Hybrid/TBC/TBA/Teams/Zoom/Webinar, nations and format words and accepts only one capitalised token or a known two-word city (test_community_calendar.py). verified_empty is set only when the EventList container is present with no rows, links or dates (or says 'no events'); a parser break returns [] and runs failed.
